description: Rework the test suites and documentation for the new To Live model. Update tests/test_tournament.py (fixtures + remove the fixed-team/top-4-per-team and Round1Assign wheel tests, add per-game-split + top-8-by-goals + boundary-tie + migration tests) and tests/test_ui.cjs (remove the single-wheel To-Live team-assign assertions, add per-game lineup + per-match submit assertions). Update README.md. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. ALL Round 2 / Rebirth / FEAT-003-per-match tests must stay green.
steps: tests/test_tournament.py fixture(): stop assigning per-player round1 'team' values. Build round1 players as {'goals':[...]} and, so advancement is deterministic, give players distinct goal totals that make the intended top-8 survivors unambiguous. Generate round1 lineups via engine.round1_lineups(s) (or let bind_rosters/evaluate handle it) so downstream round2 roster = top-8-by-total-goals. Recompute the expected round1 survivors list used by test_full_tournament (it currently expects ['p1','p2','p3','p4','p6','p7','p8','p9'] from the per-team model; the new top-8-by-goals set will differ -> set goals so a clear 8 advance and update the assertion).

Remove or rewrite tests that encode the retired model: the entire class Round1Assign (all its spin/cap/reset/targeted tests) must be DELETED. HTTP.test_round1_assign_endpoint must be DELETED. test_incorrect_team_counts's first assertion (setting a player's team and expecting round1 incomplete) must be removed/rewritten (its round2 assertion can stay if still meaningful). Update the engine import line in the test module to drop round1_assign_action and add round1_lineups / round1_lineup_action.

Update test_cut_tie_and_incomplete_extra: it currently targets the per-team 4th/5th bubble (team A p4 vs p5). Rewrite for the new all-10 8th/9th boundary bubble: construct scores so two players are tied exactly across the 8th/9th cut line, assert status TIE and survivors==[], then add extra games and assert the fold resolves it (a cut player can overtake a tied-advancing player; a clear top finisher is undisturbed). Reuse the folded total/played/average assertions pattern already in the round2 version of this test.

ADD new engine tests: (a) round1_lineups returns 5 splits, each a valid 5/5 partition covering all 10 players, and is idempotent (second call equal to first, stored on state). (b) advancement is top-8-by-total-goals and is INDEPENDENT of which players are grouped A/B: build a state, record survivors, then reroll/alter lineups (without changing goals) and assert survivors unchanged. (c) a reroll via round1_lineup_action refuses when the game already has a score (guard), and succeeds on an unscored game. (d) old-save migration: a save with round1 per-player 'team' + 'assigned' loads via validate() (team/assigned dropped, goals preserved) and round1_lineups produces valid splits afterwards. (e) per-game readiness requires all 10 scores (a single missing score keeps the game not ready and the round incomplete).

legacy_fixture(): verify it still migrates; adjust if it referenced round1 team/assigned fields in a way that now breaks. Keep test_legacy_round2_archive_and_current_save_preservation and test_tenth_game_and_migration green (they assert round1 is preserved across migration — update any round1-team expectations).

tests/test_ui.cjs: DELETE the Round 1 single-wheel assertions block (round1MatchForName lookups, 'Assign teams'/'Reset spin'/data-action=r1-reset assertions, the PUT /api/round1-assign spin assertions, the non-roster-skips-assignment and incomplete-names-note assertions, and the summary console.log about the single Name wheel auto-assigning). Keep the wheel-mode-tabs assertions that confirm NO round1 team-draw tab (those remain valid since there is still no round1 wheel mode).

tests/test_ui.cjs: ADD To Live assertions for the new model: round('round1') HTML contains the per-game A/B lineup grouping (e.g. .team-score / Team A / Team B for the selected game) and the per-player goal inputs for that game; it does NOT contain a team <select> (data-path round1.players.*.team) nor 'Assign teams' nor data-action=r1-reset. Keep/confirm the FEAT-003 per-match assertions: 'Submit Match 1 of 5', data-action=submit-match data-stage=round1, 5-match selector, popup cumulative standings, final fullscreen ADVANCE/CUT/TIE + extra-game fold. Ensure the fixture the harness builds (python3 -c ... from test_tournament import fixture) still produces a complete, scored To Live so the submit/fullscreen assertions pass.

Update README.md: rewrite the 'To Live teams from the Name wheel' section (now: there is no To-Live team assignment from the wheel; the Name wheel is an ordinary name draw). Document the new To Live model in Tournament flow step 2 (each of 5 games gets an automatic fresh random 5v5 split; teams are cosmetic; advancement is top-8-of-10 by total goals with the 8th/9th boundary-bubble extra-games tie rule). Update the Extra games section's To Live description (cut line is now 8th/9th across all 10, not 4th/5th per team). Update the final test-coverage summary paragraph to drop the retired wheel-assign coverage and mention per-game splits + top-8 advancement.
Run both suites and iterate until green: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (expect same count or adjusted; all pass) and node tests/test_ui.cjs (exit 0).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passes with zero failures/errors; no reference to round1_assign_action or the Round1Assign class remains.
node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 and its output reflects the new To Live per-game-lineup + per-match-submit assertions, with no single-wheel team-assign assertions.

New engine tests prove: valid 5/5 per-game splits covering all 10, idempotent lineups, advancement independent of A/B grouping, reroll guard, old-save migration producing splits, and all-10 per-game readiness.
All pre-existing Round 2 / Rebirth / FEAT-003 per-match-ranking tests still pass.
README.md no longer describes wheel-driven To Live team assignment and correctly documents per-game random splits + top-8-by-total-goals advancement.
findings:
Reworked tests/test_tournament.py, tests/test_ui.cjs, and README.md only. No engine/app/app.js changes (FEAT-001/002). No commit (FEAT-004 commits). Branch feat/per-match-ranking, no push.

BOTH SUITES GREEN: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests => Ran 33, OK. node tests/test_ui.cjs => exit 0. grep -n round1_assign tests/test_tournament.py => nothing. python3 -c 'import engine, app' + node --check static/app.js both clean.

tests/test_tournament.py:
- Import line: dropped round1_assign_action; added round1_lineups, round1_lineup_action.
- Added helpers spread(total,games=5) (distinct whole-number per-game goals summing to total) and _shuffle_split(seed) (a deterministic seed-varying valid 5/5 partition). Added ROUND1_TOTALS mapping giving DISTINCT totals p1:30 p2:25 p3:20 p4:15 p6:12 p7:10 p8:8 p9:6 p5:4 p10:2 -> clean top-8-by-total survivors in the SAME ORDER as the old per-team model (p1,p2,p3,p4,p6,p7,p8,p9), bottom two p5/p10 cut at 8th/9th with a clear gap. This keeps the ENTIRE downstream round2/final chain byte-identical, so test_full_tournament's survivors/round2/final/prize/game_points assertions all pass UNCHANGED.
- fixture(): no per-player round1 'team'; players built as {'goals':spread(ROUND1_TOTALS[p])}; calls round1_lineups(s) so splits persist. (final/round2 fixture bodies unchanged.)
- legacy_fixture(): unchanged and still migrates (it only sets round2 team fields which the round2 model still accepts; round1 shape comes from fixture()).
- test_incorrect_team_counts: removed the round1-team assertion; kept the round2 incomplete assertion.
- test_cut_tie_and_incomplete_extra: rewritten for the all-10 8th/9th boundary bubble. p5 set to total 6 (spread(6)) to tie p9 (6) across ranks 8-9 -> TIE + survivors==[]. First extra (p5=p9=+2) keeps the exact average tie (folded p9 goals 8/played 6); second extra (p5+5,p9+1) resolves: p5 ADVANCE (13 goals/7 played), p9 CUT (9/7); asserts clear top finisher p1 (rank1 ADVANCE, 30 goals/5 played) undisturbed. Mirrors the round2 fold assertions.
- DELETED class Round1Assign entirely; REPLACED with class Round1Lineups covering: (a) lineups are 5 valid 5/5 partitions covering all 10 + idempotent + validate round-trip; (b) advancement independent of A/B grouping (record survivors, replace all 5 splits via _shuffle_split, survivors unchanged); (c) reroll refuses a scored game (fixture is fully scored) + bad game/unknown action raise + reroll on an unscored fresh state rerolls ONLY the targeted game (patched shuffle) leaving others intact; (d) old-save migration: a hand-built save with per-player round1 'team' + round1 'assigned' passes validate() with team/assigned dropped and goals preserved, then round1_lineups produces valid splits; (e) per-game readiness needs all 10 scores (null one -> that game not ready + round incomplete, others still ready).
- DELETED HTTP.test_round1_assign_endpoint; REPLACED with HTTP.test_round1_lineup_endpoint: GET /api/state returns round1.lineups as 5 valid splits, /api/backup carries them, PUT /api/round1-lineup {action:'reroll',game:1} returns 5 valid splits, and an unknown action is a 400 (HTTPError).
- Kept legacy/migration tests green (test_legacy_round2_archive_and_current_save_preservation, test_tenth_game_and_migration) with no round1-team expectations needing change.

tests/test_ui.cjs:
- DELETED the Round 1 single-wheel assertions block (round1MatchForName/resetRound1Spin lookups, 'Assign teams'/'Reset spin'/data-action=r1-reset, PUT /api/round1-assign spin assertions, non-roster-skip + incomplete-names-note assertions, and the single-wheel summary console.log). The inline python snippet that built a state with per-player team+assigned was replaced with one that builds a plain new_state + names + round1_lineups(s).
- KEPT the wheel-mode-tabs assertions confirming NO data-wheel-mode=\"round1\"/'team draw' tab.
- ADDED To Live new-model assertions on round('round1'): contains teams-grid, Team A/Team B, team-score; a goal input (data-path round1.players.pN.goals.0) for every one of the 10 players for the selected game (de-duped set equals the 10 ids); does NOT contain a per-player team select (no round1.players.*.team), 'Assign teams', data-action=r1-reset or r1-wheel; DOES contain data-action=r1-reroll. Also asserts round1MatchForName/resetRound1Spin are undefined and spinWheel() makes NO API call (fetch throws if called) yet still sets wheelLast.name.
- KEPT all FEAT-003 per-match assertions ('Submit Match 1 of 5', data-action=submit-match data-stage=round1, 5-match selector, cumulative popup STATUS/PLAYED, final fullscreen ADVANCE/CUT + ROUND SETTLED, AVG PTS/GAME, TIE + extra-game fold with folded total 23). Updated the one post-reset assertion state.round1.players.p1.goals[0] from 4 to 6 (new fixture p1 goals = spread(30) = [6,6,6,6,6]).

README.md:
- Replaced 'To Live teams from the Name wheel' with 'To Live per-game teams': the Name wheel is a plain name draw; each of 5 games gets an automatic fresh random cosmetic 5v5 split; advancement by total goals; splits persisted/stable; optional per-game Reshuffle locked once a game is scored.
- Tournament flow step 2 rewritten: per-game random split (cosmetic), all 10 scored each game, top-8-of-10 by total goals, 8th/9th extra-games tie rule, reshuffle lock.
- Extra games To Live cut line updated from '4th and 5th within one team' to '8th and 9th across all ten players'.
- Test-coverage summary updated: dropped retired wheel-assign coverage; added per-game splits (valid 5/5, idempotent, grouping-independent advancement, reshuffle guard), all-10 readiness, 8th/9th fold, top-8 ranking, and old fixed-team save migration. Also changed a Saving/recovery line's stale 'assignments' wording to 'scores'.
